description.default: The absolute URL of the SharePoint site holding this environment's signed-acceptance library (ADR-014, ADR-G01). One site collection PER environment (provisioning/sharepoint/ensure-site.ps1's own rule: never point two environments at the same site) - this value differs per environment and is supplied by deployment settings rather than committed (C-TECH-047).
